title: Larry Y. Wilson
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Missionary to the Brazil Central Mission, 1969-71
Married Lynda Mackey 1974; Logan Utah Temple; Four children
BA in English and American Literature, Harvard, 1974; MBA Stanford Graduate School of Business, 1976.
Senior VP, Kaiser Foundation Health Plan.; Executive VP/COO of Catholic Healthcare West in San Francisco
Second Quorum of the Seventy 2011 - present
